planning.childGoal: Yhdistän plussan ja miinuksen kahdessa muutoksessa.
planning.scope: Mixed +/− facts to10 (132 pairs), four two-event stories with two selected operations/intermediate/final, missing part and sign relation including zero dual-validity. Both atomic skills AND are actual required prerequisites.
planning.evidenceLimits: Local untimed checked responses only. Model/hints are assistance; no formal mastery, fluent recall, retention, strategy proof, personal history or learning-effectiveness inference.
planning.assetProvenance: Supplied immutable user-provided v2 transparent PNG as named character; no new raster generation or implied handdrawn provenance. Mathematical SVG is original exact code, not mascot replacement.

extensions.author: Euler
extensions.simulationType: Manual discrete quantity transformations; no playback/physical clock, frames or timer. Pause/resume/reset/dispose apply to all active controls.
extensions.interaction: Both input/change commits and current visible readback before model actions/check; dependent edits retire verdict, independent model/help does not. Strict finite integer equality; blank is missing, no tolerance or semantic fallback.
extensions.integration: Required AND atomicADDFACT10/SUBFACT10, explicit two-event interpretation and arithmetic. No single-response mastery/fluency claim.
extensions.designQA: Own isolated full current shell design preview only, not actual main127; no shared header/presentation overrides or main build.
extensions.researchLimits: Primary HTML sections and copyright/terms inspected2026-10-29. No slides/video/original research/Finnish-current requirements/efficacy claims.
